$comment: The knowledge base's identity as every reader must compute it from <dir>/.semiont/config.yaml, the project file ProjectConfig.json holds. Go (apps/launcher/internal/launcher: readKBIdentity, and the name, domain, DID and resource it reads) and Rust (apps/archivist/record: kb::committed) run every case and fail on any difference; TypeScript (packages/core: kbDid and kbResource), Rust (packages/sdk-rust: kb_did, and kb_resource, the audience the gateway's tokens must carry), Python (packages/sdk-python: kb_did and kb_resource) and Go (packages/sdk-go: KbDid and KbResource) each run every case with a domain. `config` null means the file is absent; `refused` true means the file does not hold to ProjectConfig.json, and every reader of it refuses it; `name` null means a refused file names nothing; `domain`, `did` and `resource` null mean no identity is declared. Add a case here before changing any reader.

cases.config:
project:
  name: "ArXiv Research Papers"

git:
  sync: true

site:
  # Permanent did:web identity for everything this KB mints.
  domain: "the-ai-alliance.github.io:semiont-arxiv-kb"
  siteName: "ArXiv Research Papers"
cases.name: ArXiv Research Papers

cases.why: no project file: the directory name, and no identity
cases.name: bare-kb

cases.why: plain scalars, and a version, which names nothing
cases.config:
project:
  name: Plain
  version: 0.1.0
git:
  sync: false
site:
  domain: example.github.io:plain-kb
  siteName: Plain
cases.name: Plain

cases.why: a comment is not part of the value
cases.config:
project:
  name: Commented # a note
git:
  sync: true
site:
  domain: example.github.io:comment-kb # permanent
  siteName: Commented
cases.name: Commented

cases.why: escapes in a double-quoted value are decoded
cases.config:
project:
  name: "A \"quoted\" KB"
git:
  sync: true
site:
  domain: example.github.io:escape-kb
  siteName: Quoted
cases.name: A "quoted" KB

cases.why: a flow mapping is the same mapping
cases.name: Flow

cases.why: a multi-segment domain becomes a multi-segment path
cases.config:
project:
  name: Deep
git:
  sync: true
site:
  domain: example.org:group:deep-kb
  siteName: Deep
cases.name: Deep

git:
  sync: true

cases.why: a domain with white space in it is refused: no DID holds it, and it would be stamped into every event the knowledge base records
cases.config:
project:
  name: Spaced
git:
  sync: true
site:
  domain: "example.github.io:spaced kb"
  siteName: Spaced

project:
  name: ""
git:
  sync: true
site:
  domain: example.github.io:empty-name-kb
  siteName: Empty

cases.why: a sync written as text is refused
cases.config:
project:
  name: Text Sync
git:
  sync: "yes"
site:
  domain: example.github.io:text-sync-kb
  siteName: Text Sync

cases.why: a key the schema does not name is refused

  name: Misspelled

  domian: example.github.io:misspelled-kb

cases.why: a file that is not YAML is refused
